name: the engine list reports the write order
description: GET /api/file/engines answers the configured backends in the order a write will try them, lowest priority number first. Phorge's setup check reads it to tell 'the service is up' from 'the service is up and can store something'. sizeLimit is 0 for a backend that has none, which is why canWrite is a separate field: 'unlimited' and 'refuses writes' would otherwise be the same value. Credentials never appear — an entry carries only these four keys.
